title: AlgoView - Algorithm Visualizer
description: AlgoView is an interactive web platform for visualizing Data Structures and Algorithms with step-by-step animations. It helps students and developers understand algorithms like sorting, searching, graph traversal, and dynamic programming through intuitive visualizations, real-time insights, and practice problems. The platform also includes user authentication, progress tracking, analytics dashboard, and a DSA practice system.

title: SentXStock — AI Sentiment Trading Agent
description: SentXStock is an AI-powered sentiment trading advisor that analyzes financial news and social media to generate data-driven trading recommendations. It uses a 3-tier AI pipeline with FinBERT, Gemini LLM, and VADER to evaluate market sentiment from 100+ sources. The platform provides a dashboard with a sentiment gauge, portfolio analytics, risk adjustment engine, and an AI chatbot for interactive trading insights.

title: FashionFinds - Fashion E-Commerce Platform
description: FashionFinds is a full-featured fashion e-commerce web application built with Flask that provides a seamless online shopping experience. The platform allows users to browse fashion products, filter by category and brand, manage carts and wishlists, and place orders with order tracking. It includes role-based dashboards for customers, administrators, and delivery agents, along with product inventory management, authentication, email-based password reset, and admin-controlled delivery agent approvals.

title: AI Planet - No-Code AI Workflow Builder
description: AI Planet is a visual no-code/low-code platform that allows users to build intelligent AI workflows using a drag-and-drop interface. The system enables users to upload documents, process them with AI, perform semantic search using vector embeddings, and generate context-aware responses through Gemini AI. It includes workflow components such as User Query, KnowledgeBase, LLM Engine, and Output, allowing users to create AI-powered pipelines without writing code.

title: Multi-Agent AI Chatbot
description: A multitasking AI agent chatbot built during my internship at ezSCM Technology. Integrates Google Gemini API to handle diverse tasks — web search, code generation, summarisation and Q&A — in a single conversational interface.
